description: Close an open handoff when its work is DONE, alongside the arroway_log entry that records the residue. Work that removes what an open handoff exists to fix closes that handoff in the same pass — even when the handoff is someone else's. So this is also the call for someone ELSE's handoff, with a note naming what emptied it. A handoff that still carries real work, which a passer-by must never close, stays open; discarding a handoff is the human's gesture, in the panel.

handoff.description: The #handle from the read, or the full id.

note.description: One line on what landed; it points at the residue.

name: arroway_close
title: Close a handoff — the work landed
